nodes.label: main()
nodes.desc: Console-script entrypoint; explicitly unsupported to call in-process, users are pointed at runpy.

nodes.label: create_main_parser()
nodes.desc: Top-level parser; unknown options are allowed so subcommands can own their own option groups.

nodes.label: cmdoptions
nodes.desc: Factory functions for every reusable CLI option: index URLs, formats, targets, hashes, python version.

nodes.label: Command.run()/_main()
nodes.desc: run() is the command body; _main() catches the typed exception hierarchy and maps it to status codes.

nodes.label: exit status codes
nodes.desc: SUCCESS/ERROR/PREVIOUS_BUILD_DIR_ERROR constants returned to the shell.

nodes.label: IndexGroupCommand
nodes.desc: Commands that talk to package indexes share this base for index/session option handling.

nodes.label: RequirementCommand
nodes.desc: Base of install/download/wheel/lock: builds session, finder, preparer, resolver and builder.

nodes.label: RequirementsFileParser
nodes.desc: Walks a requirements file, expanding options and nested files before line-level parsing.

nodes.label: ParsedRequirement
nodes.desc: Line-level result of parsing: a requirement string plus any requirement-file options attached.

nodes.label: install_req_from_line()
nodes.desc: Turns requirement strings and editables into InstallRequirement objects via parse_req_from_line.

nodes.label: InstallRequirement
nodes.desc: One requirement's full state: specifier, marker, hashes, link, build env, metadata and install results.

nodes.label: RequirementSet
nodes.desc: The bag of resolved requirements; also drives uninstall bookkeeping for replaced packages.

nodes.label: pep723 inline metadata
nodes.desc: Reads script-inline dependency metadata so a single Python file can carry its own requirements.

nodes.label: LinkCollector
nodes.desc: Fetches index pages and find-links directories, caching HTML per URL within a session.

nodes.label: parse_links()
nodes.desc: Extracts anchor tags from an index page and classifies each into a Link with its metadata.

nodes.label: _IndexDirectorySource
nodes.desc: LinkSource implementations for index pages, local directories and remote file URLs.

nodes.label: CandidateEvaluator
nodes.desc: Scores candidates against specifiers, tags and python version to compute best_candidate.

nodes.label: evaluate_link()
nodes.desc: Classifies one link: wheel/sdist/yanked/unsupported, returning LinkType plus a reason string.

nodes.label: sort_best_candidate()
nodes.desc: Orders candidates by build tag then version, honoring binary-only and wheel-preference settings.

nodes.label: PackageFinder
nodes.desc: Public façade: find_all_candidates gathers links from every source and picks the best candidate.

nodes.label: PipSession
nodes.desc: requests.Session subclass mounting cache-control adapters, local file adapter, auth and retries.

nodes.label: CacheControlAdapter
nodes.desc: Vendored cachecontrol adapter so index pages respect HTTP caching headers on disk.

nodes.label: SafeFileCache
nodes.desc: Filesystem HTTP cache backend hardened against races and corrupt metadata.

nodes.label: MultiDomainBasicAuth
nodes.desc: Per-index credentials plus keyring integration; prompts once and caches credentials per domain.

nodes.label: Downloader.__call__()
nodes.desc: Streams one link to disk with progress reporting and cache-aware response handling.

nodes.label: LazyZipOverHTTP
nodes.desc: Reads wheel central directory over HTTP range requests so metadata needs no full download.

nodes.label: LocalFSAdapter
nodes.desc: Makes file:// URLs work through the same session interface as HTTP.

nodes.label: wheel_builder.build()
nodes.desc: Entry into building: skips already-wheels, checks cacheability, then builds one wheel per sdist.

nodes.label: _build_one_inside_env()
nodes.desc: Installs the build environment (setuptools etc.) and invokes the PEP 517 build backend.

nodes.label: _verify_one()
nodes.desc: Cross-checks the produced wheel's name against the requirement before trusting it.

nodes.label: _should_cache()
nodes.desc: Decides whether a built wheel may be cached: direct URLs and VCS checkouts differ.

nodes.label: WheelCache
nodes.desc: Top-level cache holder: one subcache for index-built wheels, one for direct URLs.

nodes.label: SimpleWheelCache
nodes.desc: Wheel cache bucket whose key is the origin page, allowing multiple cache hits per project.

nodes.label: self version check
nodes.desc: Rate-limited check whether a newer pip exists, cached locally so it runs at most every 2 weeks.
